MUNICIPAL
U. REGI
HH
24 1

MUNICIPAL ADMINISTRATION REPORT
FOR
THE YEAR 1932.

NUMBER OF CASES: One hundred and one thousand, five hundred and seventeen (101,517) cases were prosecuted in the Shanghai First Special Area District Court and the Kiangsu High Court, Second Branch, during the year 1932. Seventy-four thousand, six hundred and ninety-eight (74,698) persons failed to appear in petty bye-law cases and their bail was confiscated. In addition to the above, there were one thousand and seventy-eight (1,078) private criminal prosecutions instituted; three thousand, one hundred and eighty-one (3,181) cases were instituted by the Health and Public Works Departments for violation of Health and Public Works regulations; and five thousand, four hundred and ninety-one (5,491) cases were instituted by the Traffic Department for infringements of traffic regulations. Six hundred and two (602) cases were withdrawn on the ground that there was insufficient evidence to convict. The total number of major and minor criminal cases presented for completion was twenty-six thousand, two hundred and seventeen (26,217). Twenty-four thousand, two hundred and twenty-two (24,222) persons were convicted and one thousand, nine hundred and ninety-five (1,995) persons were acquitted. A detailed list of the number and character of such cases is appended hereto, with a summary thereof, and marked "Appendix A".

DISPOSITION OF PRISONERS: Discharge and transfer of prisoners who are part of the general population were conducted under the supervision of competent authority, according to law.

工部局
U. REGI
HH
24 1

1932年度工部局行政报告。

案件数量：1932年间，在上海第一特区地方法院及江苏高等法院第二分院提起公诉的案件共计十万一千五百一十七（101,517）起。七万四千六百九十八（74,698）人因在轻微违例案件中未出庭，其保释金被没收。除上述案件外，另有私人提起的刑事公诉一千零七十八（1,078）起；卫生处与工务处因违反卫生及工务规章而提起的案件三千一百八十一（3,181）起；交通处因违反交通规章而提起的案件五千四百九十一（5,491）起。六百零二（602）起案件因证据不足无法定罪而被撤销。提交审结的重大及轻微刑事案件总数为二万六千二百一十七（26,217）起。其中二万四千二百二十二（24,222）人被定罪，一千九百九十五（1,995）人被宣告无罪。此类案件的数量及性质详单及其摘要附后，标记为“附录A”。

囚犯处置：属于普通囚犯群体的囚犯的释放与转移，均依法在主管当局的监督下进行。
